Bengaluru to get 5 new feeder buses for Pink Line Metro

The Bangalore Metropolitan Transport Corporation (BMTC) is set to launch five dedicated feeder bus services connecting to stations on the Pink Line metro in Bengaluru. These buses will operate with a frequency of every 10 minutes, aiming to improve connectivity for metro commuters.
